errors: No arithmetic errors found in Section I; all spot-checked residues and digit groups are consistent with L_k = 307·L_{k+1} + r_k.

Section II line 3: Gauss first wrote '…591337384' and then wrote '497' above it. My long division confirms the corrected group 5913377497 and the following group 8583909606, so the correction is right.
Section II lines 8–12: the final digit groups are overwritten and only partly legible. Their correctness cannot be confirmed from the image; the section appears incomplete.
The previous page's copy of the 7th power reads …6274858960, but this page (and the check 307·L8 + 121) gives …6274855960. Either the previous-page transcription or Gauss's copy has a slip there.

results.what: 60-decimal values of 307^(-k), k = 1..24, by repeated division with recorded remainders, as input to the Gregory series for arccot 307
results.modern_name: Gregory/Machin arctangent series evaluation (Machin-type π computation by long division)
results.usually_credited_to: James Gregory (1671) for the series; John Machin (1706) for the arctangent-relation method

results.what: The same power table for 1/882 (partial, to the 12th power)
results.modern_name: Machin-like formula computation; numbers n with smooth n²+1 (Størmer-type arccot relations)
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss's 'Cyclotechnie' tables of factored n²+1 (Werke II); systematic theory by Størmer (1896)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine high-precision auxiliary table for evaluating arccot 307 and arccot 882. Gauss's work on arctangent relations and the factoring of n²+1 for computing π is documented in his Werke (Zur Cyclotechnie). Nothing here is methodologically new.

checkable.asserts: Top residue (256) is the remainder of 10^60 divided by 307
Line I.1 equals the first 60 decimals of 1/307
The marginal residues are the remainders of successive division by 307
Last group of line I.7 is 6274855960, as on this page
The corrected digit groups 5913377497 and 8583909606 in line II.3 are right
882²+1 is smooth, so 882 is useful in arccot relations
